title: yeasty gooey Brazilian corn Pão
description: A hangover-curing Brazilian dish featuring harissa spice and bonito-shave. Perfect for a weekend brunch.
instructions: Combine flour, cornmeal, harissa spice, and yeast in a large mixing bowl.
Gradually add warm water to the dry ingredients, mixing until a sticky dough forms.
Knead the dough for 10 minutes, until smooth and elastic.
Place the dough in a greased bowl, cover with a damp cloth, and let rise in a warm place for 1 hour.
Divide the dough into 4-6 equal pieces, depending on desired size.
Shape each piece into a ball and flatten slightly into a disk.
Brush the tops with unsalted butter and sprinkle with bonito shave.
Bake for 20-25 minutes, or until golden brown.
Remove from oven and sprinkle with fresh cilantro.
Serve warm, with your favorite hangover-curing toppings.
